description: This Java source file defines the exception class NumberIsTooSmallException used by the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that a number is below a specified minimum bound. It extends MathIllegalNumberException and includes information about the minimum value and whether the bound is inclusive.

classes.description: Exception indicating that a given number is smaller than the allowed minimum.
